documentation.description: Build mu-identifier and run the integration test suite. Pass an optional spec name to run a single spec, e.g. 04-cors.

host.name: start-identifier
host.comment: Start or restart the identifier service

host.name: run-test-specs
host.comment: Run a mocha test spec by name

host.name: run-invalid-config-spec
host.comment: Run the invalid config spec, skipping the identifier wait

host.name: run-revocation-spec
host.comment: Run the session revocation spec with captured session cookies

host.name: capture-session
host.comment: Establish a session and capture its cookie for revocation tests

host.name: revocation-scripts
host.comment: Invoke session revocation scripts on the identifier via mu-cli

host.name: print-summary
host.comment: Print the per-test summary after all specs have run
